# The Yard

> The Yard is a Singapore gymnastics club founded in 2016 by Rosanna Trigg, operated by People In Motion Pte. Ltd. (UEN 201535741C), with four centres: Jurong, Bukit Timah, Dempsey and Dover. Recreational gymnastics (Gym Tots, KinderTots, FUNdamentals) runs at all four centres; a selection-based competitive WAG/MAG pathway trains at the Jurong High Performance hub. Trial classes are bookable at every centre (fee shown at booking); competitive entry starts with a free assessment.

Key facts:
- Recreational programs: Gym Tots (18 months–3), KinderTots (3–4) and FUNdamentals (5–10) at ALL four centres; Warriors (advanced recreational) at Bukit Timah and Dover; Senior Warriors (10–16) at Dover; Boys Tots / Boys Fundamentals at Dempsey and Dover; Heroes, Legends and Gladiator are progression levels reached via a coach.
- Competitive WAG/MAG: by assessment and invitation only (assessment is free). SGLP/USAG Levels 1–10, squads train 6–24 hrs/week, August–July season. High Performance hub: Jurong (20,000 sq ft Olympic-grade arena, opened Nov 2025). Yard-hosted meets: Lion City Classic (April) and Diamond Classic (March) at Jurong; annual Christmas Show in December.
- Other programs (selected centres only): Ninja Zone at Bukit Timah and Dempsey ONLY; Tumbling & Trampoline (10–16) at Jurong ONLY; Freestyle at Dover (camps); Adult 16+ — Open Session at Jurong and Adult Foundation Gymnastics at Bukit Timah.
- Camps: 5-day holiday camps (Mon–Fri, 3 hrs/day) every Singapore school holiday (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec). Gymnastics camps at all four centres; Ninja camps at Bukit Timah + Dempsey; High Performance camps at Jurong; Freestyle camp at Dover.
- Birthday parties at all four centres: 90-minute coached session + 30 minutes in a decorated party room; Mini/Mega/Mighty packages up to 24 guests; nut-free venue, self-catered.
- Centres: Jurong — 1 Venture Avenue, #03-03A, Perennial Business City, S608521, +65 6816 8022 · Bukit Timah — 9 King Albert Park, #B1-01, KAP Mall, S598332, +65 6914 9669 · Dempsey — 72 Loewen Road, Dempsey Hill, S248828, +65 6914 9660 · Dover — 1010 Dover Road, #01-01, SPGG, S139658, +65 6914 9662.
- Skills system: 20-skill Skills Matrix per level (18/20 to advance); skills medalled Bronze/Silver/Gold; assessments 3× per year (Terms 1, 3, 5).
- Every centre: nut-free, FIG-certified apparatus, parent viewing areas (no filming), safeguarding-led (Safe Sport Singapore framework).
- Tagline: Move · Play · Belong · Grow.
